quest.513011ED63C6B222.quest_desc: The smallest useful Induction Matrix is 3×4×3: it needs both a Cell and a Provider, so a 1×1×1 interior is insufficient. Use 24 Induction Casings for the frame, eight Structural Glass and two Ports for the remaining faces.
Place one Basic Induction Cell and one Basic Induction Provider inside. Set one port to input and the other to output. The Cell determines capacity; the Provider determines throughput.
The quest verifies the kit. Test operation by connecting a source and consumer, then checking the stored energy in its interface.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.

quest.514D111250CFCDBB.quest_desc: Smallest working Mekanism turbine: 5×5×5. Its frame uses 44 Turbine Casings; the rest of the shell is 51 Structural Glass, two Valves and one Vent. Place the Vent at the Rotational Complex’s height or above.

Above the floor centre, place one Rotor with one Blade. Put the Rotational Complex above it and fill the surrounding interior layer with eight Pressure Dispersers. Put one Electromagnetic Coil directly above the Complex.

One Valve accepts steam; the other outputs FE. This is a small starter rig. Add a Saturating Condenser for water recovery and more blades after assembly; match steam input to the turbine’s actual throughput.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
quest.514D111250CFCDBB.title: Mekanism Turbine: Minimum Kit
quest.514D1127DFAD1A15.quest_desc: The Solar Neutron Activator converts nuclear waste into polonium, and the Pressurized Reaction Chamber completes the pellet recipe with its additional inputs. Keep separate lines and buffers for radioactive chemicals; this material leads to later systems.
quest.514D1127DFAD1A15.title: Waste → polonium
quest.514D1138F546A4D2.quest_desc: Connect Radioactive Waste Barrels to the reactor's waste output and reserve capacity. Verify ports and chemical transport before feeding fuel, and monitor the output so a full buffer is noticed.
quest.514D1138F546A4D2.title: A dedicated radioactive waste output
quest.514D113E1E8CF8B1.quest_desc: The fusion reactor has a fixed rounded 5×5×5 layout: 36 Frames, a Controller, a Laser Focus Matrix, three Ports and 25 Reactor Glass. Follow Mekanism’s diamond-shaped faces rather than filling the corners of a normal cube.
Place the Controller in the centre of the top face. Two ports accept deuterium and tritium separately; the third exports FE. Aim the ignition laser through the Laser Focus Matrix.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.

Assemble the Fusion Reactor and connect the prepared fuel and laser ignition system to its Laser Focus Matrix. To start the automatic observation, right-click the Fusion Reactor Controller on the formed reactor with your main hand without holding Shift.

Remain in the same dimension within 16 blocks of the controller you clicked. Maintain at least 10 seconds of operation (200 server ticks): the fueled reaction continues and current energy generation is positive. Energy may be sent directly to consumers.

The quest completes while the reactor is running after the full observation interval. Moving beyond 16 blocks, changing dimension, leaving the world or dismantling the reactor interrupts observation; after returning, right-click the controller again. The component kit is checked by the separate item objectives.
Guaranteed return of consumed components: 1 × Fusion Reactor Frame.
Claim the refund after you or your team actually manufacture Fusion Reactor Controller. An item in storage or an already completed quest alone does not prove crafting.
quest.514D113E1E8CF8B1.title: Fusion: fuel, laser, operating cycle
quest.514D1144187ECDB7.quest_desc: Supply sufficient water, provide a steam output and configure the Fission Reactor Logic Adapter. Check cooling and your shutdown method before confirming the manual objective. Holding the pump and pipes alone does not demonstrate a working circuit.
quest.514D1144187ECDB7.title: Cooling and shutdown first
quest.514D114878C1E1BB.quest_desc: The SPS uses a fixed rounded 7×7×7 layout: 60 placed SPS Casings, 123 Structural Glass, three SPS Ports and one Supercharged Coil. These are finished construction blocks; casings consumed while crafting the ports are not counted again.
The ports serve polonium input, antimatter output and power. Place the Coil inside, directly behind the power port, and leave the rest of the interior empty.
Inventory tasks verify the kit. Once formed, supply polonium and sufficient FE; the following Antimatter Pellet quest checks the resulting product.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
quest.514D114878C1E1BB.title: SPS: Complete Construction Kit
quest.514D1149705848EC.quest_desc: The EMC Core connects this route to a final campaign component. Follow its recipe in JEI and reserve the required materials. Completing an item objective does not replace crafting it or award production unlocks merely for obtaining it.
quest.514D1149705848EC.title: Antimatter for the EMC core
quest.514D114E75256187.quest_desc: Produce deuterium from heavy water and tritium from the lithium line through a Solar Neutron Activator. Prepare the Hohlraum and the required D-T Fuel form for ignition. Separate the streams and verify continuous supply to the reactor.
quest.514D114E75256187.title: Two fusion fuel streams
quest.514D1193C52093DB.quest_desc: Yellow Cake Uranium passes through oxidation and further chemistry to Uranium Hexafluoride, which the Isotopic Centrifuge turns into Fissile Fuel. Prepare the fluorite and sulfur reagent lines and inspect the sequence in JEI. The side quests for liquid buckets are optional samples, not requirements for transporting fuel.
quest.514D1193C52093DB.title: Uranium → chemical line → fuel
quest.514D11CD9798EC9F.quest_desc: Minimum fission reactor: 3×4×3. Its 34 shell positions are 30 Fission Reactor Casings and four Ports. Inside, place one Fuel Assembly and a Control Rod Assembly directly above it.
Use separate ports for fuel, water, steam and waste; configure outputs with a Configurator. The following quest adds a shutdown Logic Adapter in place of one casing.
This quest gathers the construction kit. The operating cycle is checked separately after coolant, fuel and waste handling are ready.
The tasks check each material and quantity without consuming it. Hold the kit before placing it, then complete the separate formation or operation check where this quest has one.
quest.514D11CD9798EC9F.title: Fission Reactor: Shell and Fuel Assembly
quest.514D11E025B689EF.quest_desc: Plutonium uses another nuclear waste processing branch. Check its chemical sequence and pellet recipe in JEI, then direct part of the flow into the late components that need it. This does not replace reactor waste handling or cooling.
quest.514D11E025B689EF.title: Another waste route: plutonium
quest.514D11E562C03F82.quest_desc: Convert the SPS output into an Antimatter Pellet using its recipe. The chain now has an item output for final components; scale it after polonium and energy supply are stable.
quest.514D11E562C03F82.title: The first SPS output
quest.514D11FDEEB7D32B.quest_desc: This route goes from protective equipment and measurements to cooled fission, steam recovery and waste processing. Prepare a Dosimeter and Geiger Counter, then plan the waste output. The side advancements for radiation exposure are not needed to start the reactor.
quest.514D11FDEEB7D32B.title: Prepare the nuclear site
quest.514D11FF5A4363E6.quest_desc: Prepare coolant, steam and waste outputs, and a reliable way to shut down the Fission Reactor. To start the automatic observation, right-click a Fission Reactor Casing on the formed reactor with your main hand without holding Shift.

Remain in the same dimension within 16 blocks of the block you clicked. Maintain at least 10 seconds of operation (200 server ticks): the reactor is active and burns fuel, its temperature stays below 1200 K, damage remains zero, and its fluid or chemical coolant tank is not empty.

Then shut down the reactor and wait for fuel burning to stop while retaining coolant, a temperature below 1200 K and zero damage. The quest completes after this normal shutdown; at normal server speed, observation runs once per second.
Moving beyond 16 blocks, changing dimension, leaving the world or dismantling the reactor interrupts observation. After returning, right-click the formed casing again and perform the complete cycle.
quest.514D11FF5A4363E6.title: A controlled first fission cycle
